tldr_text:
Gulf nations intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies on Wednesday following United States strikes on an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian army targeted United States drone and missile installations at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem base with combat drones. Bahrain reported intercepting Iranian aerial attacks for the third time in five days.

A United States district judge in Brooklyn sentenced Asif Merchant to 330 months in prison for attempting to commit an act of terrorism transcending national boundaries and murder for hire. Federal prosecutors stated that Merchant traveled to the United States in April 2024 to recruit individuals for political assassinations at the behest of Iran. A federal jury convicted Merchant in March after a trial that began in late February.

Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao defended military readiness and personnel conditions during a confirmation hearing before the Senate Armed Services Committee on Tuesday. Cao disclosed that the Navy restored and fired expired munitions during the conflict with Iran by modifying their condition codes. Weapons previously cataloged as Code Echo and Code Foxtrot had been recoded and deployed.

The Israeli Knesset elected Matan Kahana as its new speaker in a 66 to 52 vote to replace outgoing speaker Amir Ohana of the Likud party. Kahana secured the position with the backing of Jewish-led opposition parties and Arab-led parties including Ra'am and the Joint List. The election marks the first major parliamentary move by opponents of caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following the inconclusive October 27 legislative election.

A road span of the Kerch Bridge connecting mainland Russia to the Crimean Peninsula collapsed into the water following back-to-back Ukrainian strikes utilizing drones and missiles. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the operation as an SSU action conducted over several weeks to dismantle Russian air defenses before the strike. The operation deployed Palianytsia drones, Neptune missiles, Ruta and FP-1 drones, and a Flamingo missile.

A liquefied petroleum gas tanker caught fire and was abandoned by its crew after being struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday. The Panama-flagged vessel MT Tara Gas was attacked off Oman's Musandam Peninsula roughly two nautical miles from the coast according to Oman's Maritime Security Centre. Omani authorities carried out a rescue operation, evacuating 24 crew members from the burning ship while India's Ministry of External Affairs stated that 21 of those crew members were Indian nationals.

The White House withdrew Dr. Heidi Overton's nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration amid indications she lacked sufficient support from Senate Republicans to secure confirmation. The Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee had scheduled a vote on her nomination for Wednesday. President Donald Trump nominated Overton in August to succeed former Commissioner Marty Makary, who resigned in May.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy requested $50 billion in emergency funding from Congress to upgrade the air traffic control system in a letter co-signed by FAA chief Bryan Bedford and White House budget director Russell Vought. The funding breakdown includes over $10 billion for a digital architecture, over $10 billion for airport infrastructure, $10 billion for five new air traffic control centers, and $10 billion for up to 140 towers. Lawmakers from both parties raised concerns about the funding request, noting that previous appropriations of $12.5 billion remain partially unspent.

A classified internal communications network used by the National Security Agency went offline on Tuesday, prompting the agency to stagger arrival times for personnel at its headquarters in Fort Meade, Maryland. The internal intranet known as NSA Net facilitates the exchange of classified information and secure communications across the intelligence agency. The National Security Agency stated that the disruption occurred during scheduled routine maintenance while U.S. officials stated there was no indication that the network outage was caused by a cyberattack.

President Donald Trump addressed reporters on the South Lawn of the White House before departing on Marine One, fielding questions on domestic infrastructure, foreign policy, and administration personnel. When an NBC News correspondent asked whether the administration had focused on Washington construction projects while commercial airline networks experienced disruptions, Trump defended recent work on the executive mansion. Trump stated that the White House had 18 broken windows and peeling plaster. ===AUDIO_SCRIPT===

## TITLE
A: From Void News, this is On Air. It's Wednesday, November eighteenth.

## LEAD | Strikes Spark Gulf Missile Interceptions

## SECOND | New York Police Unit Disbanded
B: In New York City, Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced the formal dissolution of the New York Police Department Strategic Response Group on Monday. The specialized unit, established in 2015 with five hundred officers, handled both counterterrorism operations and crowd management during large-scale demonstrations including pro-Palestinian protests. Mayor Zohran Mamdani states that protest responses and counterterrorism functions must be separated.
B: The dissolved unit is replaced by a civilian-led Community Dialogue and De-escalation Division within the Office of Community Safety. A specialized dialogue team of thirty uniformed officers named the First Amendment Support Team operates alongside it within the Community Affairs Bureau.
A: Former New York City Mayor Eric Adams criticized the decision in a public statement. Former New York City Mayor Eric Adams argues that non-violent de-escalation officers cannot manage violent mobs or replace a dedicated tactical unit. Civil rights advocates and City Council member Chi Ossé praised the move, while Mayor Zohran Mamdani additionally endorsed the Communities United to Reject Brutality Act to regulate police responses to First Amendment activities.

Duffy defended the request during a closed-door briefing on Capitol Hill on Tuesday after a nationwide ground stop halted departing flights for more than four hours.

Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton attributed the network disruption to the application of a software patch designed to address major vulnerabilities discovered in October.

## OPINION | The Strait Of Hormuz Claims A Nine Month Calm
A: This is Void Opinion. Through a conservative lens today. The Strait of Hormuz claims a nine month calm.
A: Kuwait and Bahrain reported intercepting hostile drone and missile attacks launched by Iran immediately following the strike. These military exchanges punctuate a prior period of relative calm and disrupt the ongoing nine-month conflict. Regional energy markets react immediately to the closure of maritime transit lanes and the targeting of critical infrastructure. Global prices respond to the renewed hostility along the shipping corridor.
A: We observe that state interventionism and foreign commitments inevitably invite retaliatory violence upon nations that finance or shelter military installations. Foreign entanglements yield predictable financial and physical tolls on regional populations who never consented to hosting foreign military assets.
A: Proponents of intervention argue that forward deployment preserves regional stability and secures vital trade routes against hostile actors. The evidence from the Strait of Hormuz suggests the exact opposite outcome. Permanent military posture attracts the very strikes it intends to deter, widening the conflict zone to include neighboring states that seek commercial neutrality.
A: We must recognize that when great powers project force abroad, peripheral states absorb the secondary costs. Kuwait and Bahrain now manage incoming drones because foreign installations sit on their sovereign soil. We cannot insulate domestic populations from the fiscal and security burdens of interventionism once the architecture of conflict is established. We carry the responsibility of examining these costs before the next escalation consumes regional commerce and civilian safety.

## CLOSE
